ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Who is the top predator in this food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the diagram is “TERRESTRIAL FOOD WEB,” showing a terrestrial food web containing labels such as Grasses, Insects, Shrew, Mouse, Rabbit, Deer, Snake, and Cougar. The arrows indicate food or energy flowing from the eaten party to the predator, for example grass points to rabbit and deer, and the arrows from rabbit and deer further point to Cougar. Reasoning: The top predator is an animal that has prey pointing to it, but no other animal in the diagram eating it. Cougar receives arrows from rabbit and deer, and there is no arrow showing it being preyed on by other animals, so it is the top predator in this food chain.
